title: Kwigunga munsi y'ikiganza cya kure
intro: Tekereza ahantu hatuje kure y’abantu basanzwe, aho ubwitange buhura n’itegeko ridasanzwe. Umugaragu wenyine yiherera mu butungane no mu cyizere, ashyigikiwe n’ibyo yagenewe bitagaragara. Ahakikije ubugingo hateraniye ibimenyetso birwanya ibisobanuro bisanzwe, mu gihe amagambo yo gushidikanya ategereje kure y’aho umuntu yiherera. Egera utege amatwi, kuko ukuri hano kuzavuguruza buri gitekerezo cyose.
clues: Nariyeguriye gusenga ndi wenyine, nshyigikiwe n'ibyo nhabwa n'Umwami wanjye.
Nakiriye inkuru nziza y'uko Allah yantoye mu bagore bose bo ku isi.
Nagiye ahantu kure mu burasirazuba, nihishe abantu banjye, ubwo umwuka wanyerekaga mu ishusho y'umuntu utunganye.
Nasamye inda y'umwana ku ijambo ry'Imana nubwo nta muntu wigeze ankoraho.
Narihanganiye imirimo yo mu rugo ndi njyenyine munsi y'igiti cy'umukindo maze numva ijwi rimpumuriza rikoresheje umugezi munsi yanjye n'amatafari mashya yo kurya no kunywa.
Nasubiye mu muryango wanjye ntwaye umwana wanjye w’uruhinja, ndahira guceceka, maze umwana wanjye aravuga kuva akiri umwana kugira ngo amburanira nk'umugaragu wa Allah.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Yayoboye urugendo rwo kuva mu nyanja yari yaragabanutse

Gusama mu buryo bw'igitangaza no kubyara uri wenyine munsi y'ikiganza
Yamizwe n'ifi nini mu nyanja nini
